messages.subject: Trouble installing natverse
messages.body_plain:
I'm trying to install natverse today, and I'm getting the following error:

Running `R CMD build`...
* checking for file 'C:\Users\arm446\AppData\Local\Temp\Rtmp6HfAyi\remotes377c3167745a\natverse-natverse-246a410/DESCRIPTION' ... OK
* preparing 'natverse':
* checking DESCRIPTION meta-information ... ERROR
Malformed Authors@R field:
  <text>:13:24: unexpected symbol
12:       person(given = "Alexander”,
13:              family = "Bates
                           ^

See section 'The DESCRIPTION file' in the 'Writing R Extensions'
manual.
STDOUT:
* checking for file 'C:\Users\arm446\AppData\Local\Temp\Rtmp6HfAyi\remotes377c3167745a\natverse-natverse-246a410/DESCRIPTION' ... OK
* preparing 'natverse':
* checking DESCRIPTION meta-information ... ERROR
Malformed Authors@R field:
  <text>:13:24: unexpected symbol
12:       person(given = "Alexander”,
13:              family = "Bates
                           ^

See section 'The DESCRIPTION file' in the 'Writing R Extensions'
manual.
STDERR:

Error: Failed to install 'natverse' from GitHub:
  Failed to `R CMD build` package, try `build = FALSE`.

I see that there is a weird quotation mark character after the name Alexander, which may be causing the problem.

Thanks for any help you can provide,
Andrew

messages.subject: Re: NBLAST online problem
messages.body_plain:
Dear Dr. Greg Jefferis,

I am facing the same problem:
I am trying to upload a tracing for NBLAST. Whenever I upload the swc file and then I select the template brain (JFRC2) I immediately get the error message "Error: An error has occurred. Check your logs or contact the app author for clarification."

If I select the template brain first and upload the file afterwards, I don't get the error message. But nothing happens once I click "NBLAST".

I tried to refresh the page several times and also tried to run it on mozilla firefox, chrome and Safari.

Do you by chance have any advice on that?

Thank you very much in advance!

Kind regards,
Lea
